news.title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
news.text: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.

news.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
news.text: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.

news.text: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

news.text: Ethereum Foundation backs Keccak-256 to counter quantum, AI threats Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma told Cointelegraph that AI poses a more immediate threat as Ethereum prepares for one of its biggest security overhauls since the Merge.

news.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
news.text: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

news.text: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.

news.title: Ripple is worth $90 a share to one fund and $300 to another, SEC filings show
news.text: Ripple is worth $90 a share to one fund and $300 to another, SEC filings show Two SEC-registered funds open to ordinary investors marked Ripple stock 70% apart on Sept. 30, and the lower mark sits barely above what the other fund paid in 2018.
